description: Render one or more named worksheets of row objects to a downloadable .xlsx workbook. Each sheet is a name plus an array of row objects (property → scalar), with an optional column spec controlling header label, value type, width, and number/date format. An empty rows array yields a header-only sheet; provide at least one sheet. Returns a delivery envelope with a documentId, resource URI, sheetCount, byte size, and inline base64 when small enough. The natural export stage for tabular data pulled from another server — reshape its rows into sheets[] and render.

sheets.description: One or more named worksheets to render into the workbook.

items.description: One named worksheet of tabular rows.

columns.description: Optional ordered column spec. When omitted, columns derive from the first row keys.

items.description: Formatting spec for one spreadsheet column.

format.description: Excel number/date format string, e.g. "#,##0.00" or "yyyy-mm-dd".

header.description: Display label for the column header cell.

key.description: Row-object property name this column reads from.

type.description: Cell value type. `date` expects ISO 8601 string row values.

name.description: Worksheet name (the tab label). Excel constraints: 1–31 characters, unique across the workbook (case-insensitive), no * ? : \ / [ ] characters, and no leading or trailing apostrophe.

rows.description: Row objects (property → scalar). An empty array produces a header-only sheet.

name: docgen_export_spreadsheet

document.description: Delivery envelope for a rendered document — metadata plus resource/inline byte access.

byteSize.description: Size of the rendered artifact in bytes.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the document was rendered.

documentId.description: Opaque id minted by the render/export/fill tool — the chaining key for docgen_get_document and the docgen://document/{id} resource. Format `doc_` + 24 url-safe chars. Obtainable ONLY from a render/export/fill tool output; not guessable or constructible.

downloadUrl.description: Reserved for a future HTTP download route; not emitted in v1 (the field is always absent). Fetch the bytes via resourceUri or inlineBase64 instead.

inlineBase64.description: The document bytes, base64-encoded. Present when the artifact is at or under the inline threshold; omitted (field absent) when larger — fetch via the resource URI instead.

mimeType.description: Mime type of the rendered artifact — PDF or xlsx.

pageCount.description: Number of pages — present for PDF documents (render_pdf, fill_form) only.

resourceUri.description: Stable read URI `docgen://document/{documentId}` resolving to the document.

sheetCount.description: Number of worksheets — present for xlsx documents (export_spreadsheet) only.

ttlSecondsRemaining.description: Seconds until the stored artifact expires and becomes unreadable.

engine.description: The rendering engine that produced the workbook.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `empty_workbook`: The sheets array was empty — no worksheets to render. `invalid_sheet_name`: A worksheet name is blank, over 31 characters, contains * ? : \ / [ ], begins or ends with an apostrophe, or duplicates another sheet name (case-insensitive). `document_too_large`: The rendered workbook exceeded the configured maximum document size. `render_timeout`: Rendering exceeded the configured time budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.
